item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, hundreds of deep-sea species will go extinct. We must protect the ocean before irreversible destruction begins.

2. Commercial deep-sea mining will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We stand for protecting these species and the living seafloor they depend on.

3. We will not accept a future where commercial deep-sea mining wipes out hundreds of deep-sea species. The deep ocean is alive, and it deserves protection.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

The deep ocean is home to remarkable species, many of them found nowhere else on Earth. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will drive hundreds of deep-sea species extinct. We cannot accept that loss as the price of extracting minerals from the seafloor. Once these species disappear, no promise of restoration can bring them back. We believe the choice is clear: protect the deep ocean before commercial mining begins. That means standing with the life that thrives in its depths and rejecting an industry that would destroy it. We are committed to defending this extraordinary ecosystem, and we invite you to join us in making sure it remains alive for generations to come.
